scope: Offline controller and fake-port cost only; no ROS, real SDK, or hardware evidence.

methodology.pairing: Persistent workers; Python/C++ order reverses each round, core order rotates.
methodology.timing: CPU process time and monotonic wall time only inside bulk loops; setup/RSS/JSON/IPC excluded.
methodology.memory: RSS in KiB before setup, before loop and after loop; VmHWM is cumulative post-exec address-space peak, not per-sample allocation.
methodology.baseline: Separate empty-loop samples are reported, never subtracted.
methodology.gripper_unit: One request with immediate fake actuation; commands cycle 0,25,50,75,100.
methodology.arm_unit: One 2 ms synthetic streaming step with events/feedback drained.
methodology.chassis_unit: One synthetic 4/8 ms control tick including submit and event drain; original Python timing/locking included; C++ host uses one mutex.
methodology.trace: All preflight writes, flags, numeric positions, counters and terminal/current state checked before timing.

semantic_checks: passed: full preflight traces and every measured pair snapshot
